102088.ov: Mirza: The Untold Story is based on the legendary love story of Mirza and Sahiba. Mirza is being played by Gippy Grewal and Sahiba is played by Mandy Takhar. Mirza and Sahiba fall in love with each other at a very young age.

1026376.ov: Arjun and Mahi have been married for 4-5 years, but their relationship is not what it used to be. Now they are hellbent on divorcing each other. Their common friends, Gagan, and Jasleen, try to patch things up. While doing it they plan a holiday together which gets cancelled somehow.

1362248.ov: A girl longed to accompany her father on his journey to India to bid farewell to her ailing grandmother, but was not allowed. During a turbulent car ride home after picking up her grieving father from the airport, she struggles to shield him from the weight of her silent yearning.

1499848.ov: A couple runs away to marry and starts a new life with their daughter. But years later, a mysterious girl enters their world, shaking their bond to the core. The wife slowly uncovers a side of her husband she never knew. As truths come crashing down, she faces a tough choice.

1627976.ov: Hashtag Star follows the story of a social media influencer. Just when everything seems perfect, a forgotten mistake from her past resurfaces. As secrets discloses in the public eye, a celebrated social media influencer is forced to confront the truth, testing her reputation, relationships, and the cost of online fame.
